noRoot: No root directory was given to scan.
rulesCorrupt: Rules file {file} is not valid JSON with rules[].
badRegex: Rule {rule} has an invalid regular expression.
scanTimeout: Scanning {path} exceeded {ms} ms and was stopped (possible hostile regular expression).
gitleaksMissing: gitleaks is not installed; only the native engine is used.
remediation.secret: Rotate the secret and move it to an environment variable; leave the field empty in the repo.
remediation.identifier: Replace the identifier with a synthetic value from mocks/.
remediation.url: Move the URL with credentials to an environment variable.
remediation.host: Replace the real host with the AI environment one.
remediation.email: Replace the address with a synthetic one (@example.com).
remediation.guid: Replace the identifier with a test GUID.
remediation.bucket: Replace the bucket with the AI environment one.
remediation.sdk-key: Rotate the SDK key and move it to per-environment configuration.
remediation.file: Remove the file from the repository and purge history; rotate whatever it contains.
remediation.pii: Replace the personal data with a synthetic value (`bot-secure mocks`).
